checks.name: 3D orbit, pan, zoom and fit inspect terrain without creating an edit
unaccepted numeric draft survives refresh and remains editable until reset
drag-created amber draft survives refresh and reset clears it
edited node rings track multiple changes independently of selection and survive refresh
point review shows exact deltas and individually reverts edits without changing saved terrain
exact XYZ edits survive refresh and invalid coordinates preserve the prior draft
typing coordinates updates viewport without a preview click and never saves automatically
acceptance survives server token rotation while the edited page remains open
reset returns to saved terrain rather than the original fixture
closing browser and restarting server retains the accepted terrain
a subsequent accepted edit creates the next revision
lost save response retains a retry that does not duplicate publication
reset after an unavailable save clears pending state and permits editing
recovery copy records the saved revision without accepting a preview
undo previews, cancels and accepts through a new saved revision
saved history previews and restores an older revision while retaining later history
stale pending edits reapply as a reviewable preview and survive reload before acceptance
same-point conflict retains preview and pending request for manual resolution
offline pending preview restores on reload and Reload saved without publishing
reload reconciles an already committed pending request instead of restoring a proposal
browser reports no uncaught errors

digest_encoding: sha256 UTF-8 with CRLF normalized to LF
limits: Synthetic local fixture in desktop Chrome; no physical-device, power-loss or multi-user qualification.
Database isolated from the user saved-demo database.
